fact: UNHCR's 2024 call for expression of interest states the current population of refugees and asylum-seekers in Lesotho is 623 and that the Refugee Coordinating Unit receives and interviews asylum-seekers.
title: Call for Expression of Interest CFEI/HCR/LES/2024/001: Social Assistance to forcibly displaced populations including refugees, asylum-seekers, and stateless persons in Lesotho
